value.title: Delivery deadlock: pij's own staged text holds a seat forever
value.summary: pij-fleet#86: a `/compact` control delivery staged into a Claude seat's composer never committed; pij then holds that job, and every later message to the seat, as composer-busy against its own leftover text, retrying every ~5 s with two tmux launches each, forever.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Live on 2026-10-28/29. Seats pij-elated-walrus (%108) and pij-practical-marmot (%105), workers of the osk prime pij-collective-eagle. Each received a `--command compact` delivery from eagle (jobs 12791 at 18:46 and 12836 at 22:14). The staged submit pasted `/compact` into the composer but never committed; abort_staged_inner (crates/tmux/src/lib.rs) appended STAGED_SUBMIT_RECOVERY and released the pane. The job stayed pending and now sees a non-empty composer (draft_sha constant: its own `/compact` plus the recovery notice) and defers as composer-busy: 9,136 and 6,758 deferrals, about every 5 s, each costing `tmux.atomically reserve staged submit` plus `tmux.restore pane input and release ownership`. Delivery is FIFO per seat, so 6 later messages to walrus and 2 to marmot (from eagle and pij-sunny-flyingfish) have been stuck behind it since 18:46. Neither the sender nor the seat is told. These retries are now most of the daemon's remaining launches (~0.8 of ~1/s). Pane captures: assets/evidence/. Rulings: assets/rulings.md.

sections.name: goals
value: A control command that cannot commit fails with a named reason; it never wedges the seat.
pij never mistakes its own staged leftover for a human draft.
A held delivery backs off, costs no launches while waiting, and is surfaced to its sender.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Typing into a composer that holds a human draft (the composer gate stays).
Changing how messages (not control commands) are transported.

value.claim: Diagnosis. Reproduce on main with a canary Claude seat you spawn (`pij send <canary> --command compact`, in states like the stuck seats: idle, and after a long turn), and name why the staged `/compact` never committed: the commit-authorization check, Claude's slash-command menu changing the composer rendering, timing, or something else. Record it with captured panes and events in assets/evidence/diagnosis.md before fixing. If it does not reproduce, say what was tried and fix the deadlock regardless (ac-0002..0004).

Own-text recognition. When a staged submit is aborted, the job records exactly what pij left in the composer (draft hash of the staged text plus the notice). A later attempt that finds exactly that text recognises it as pij's own, never as a human draft, and then either (a) clears its own text and fails the job with a named reason, or (b) commits it if it is still a valid submission. Anything else in the composer (any human edit) is still a human draft and is never touched. Test both: own leftover vs. own leftover plus one human keystroke.

Held deliveries are bounded and surfaced. A composer-busy hold backs off (state the schedule and cap). After a stated limit, the sender gets a named notice (`delivery.held` surfaced to the sender's inbox or similar), and a control command that cannot run fails terminally instead of blocking later messages to the same seat. Ordinary messages behind a failed control command are then delivered in order. Test: control head fails → the 6 queued messages deliver in order.

Cost (AGENTS.md § Resource cost). While a delivery waits, the composer check costs no process launch: read the composer through the control-mode capture before reserving, and reserve (which launches) only when it looks submittable. Live before/after receipts with `pij-rs --json ping`; the prime takes the deployed reading. With the two stuck seats cleared, `tmux.atomically reserve staged submit` must not grow while nothing is deliverable.
value.note: Pre-deploy proof in lg-0004; awaits the prime's deployed pij-rs --json ping reading.

value.claim: Docs. docs/how (delivery / composer gate / control commands) describes the abort path, own-text recognition, the hold schedule, the sender notice and the terminal failure.

Proof. Every behaviour change has a test RED on main (quoted) and green on the branch, using the recorded pane captures as fixtures where they apply. Mutants: own-text treated as human; no backoff; no sender notice; control failure still blocks the queue. Each turns its test red, then is restored. Scoped cargo tests, `just rust-check`, clippy -D warnings, fmt; GitHub CI green on the exact head. Anything not run is NOT RUN with its reason.

value.title: Diagnose and fix the staged-submit deadlock
value.brief: One phase: reproduce with a canary, name why the staged /compact never committed, stop pij mistaking its own leftover for a human draft, bound and surface held deliveries, back off without launches, docs, mutants, PR. CS 3.
